authenticity_review: The image demonstrates exceptional photorealism in surface rendering: the bagel exhibits accurate golden-brown coloration, glossy glaze, blistered crust texture, and properly distributed sesame/poppy seeds. Pig fur shows fine bristle detail, wet nose reflections, and natural eye highlights. Lighting and shadows are coherent across all elements. However, two significant issues reduce authenticity: (1) Scale inconsistency—the bagel spans the combined width of three piglets, making it ~3x larger than a real bagel relative to piglet size (a standard 10-12cm bagel would be smaller than a single piglet's head); this is a clear generative scaling artifact. (2) Structural ambiguity in pig limbs—the animal pose auditor flagged MEDIUM risk (35% low-confidence keypoints), and visual inspection confirms hind legs/hooves lack crisp definition, appearing slightly merged with the wooden floor and bagel base. These defects prevent a higher authenticity score despite otherwise excellent rendering quality.
key_defects: Scale inconsistency: Bagel is unrealistically large relative to piglets (spans width of all three vs. expected <1 piglet head width)
Limb structural ambiguity: Hind legs/hooves show soft edges and partial fusion with floor/bagel (confirmed by pose auditor 35% low-confidence keypoints)
